contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Marius (269), Reece period 13, cf. Cunetio no. 2507:4. Obverse description: Radiate bust probably cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C MAVRIVS [--]. Reverse description: Possibly Victory right holding wreath aloft. Reverse inscription: [--]VG. Diameter: 18.6mm, Weight: 1.89gms, die axis: possibly 12
